PROGRAM OBJECTIVE: Complete readablePaths confinement across every read-like agent tool. Preserve unrestricted behavior when readablePaths is absent. Add deterministic coverage in test/readable-paths-complete.test.mjs.

CONSTRAINTS: Keep confinement inside src/agent-tools.mjs.; Do not weaken direct read or writablePaths enforcement.; No out-of-scope filename, matching line, or file bytes may appear in a refusal or filtered result.; All existing tests must remain green.; Use structured refusals rather than throwing for model-selected out-of-readable-scope list and search bases.
